info.description:
REST and WebSocket API for Krkn chaos engineering operator.

**API Versions:**
- **v1** - REST API with polling (deprecated but maintained)
- **v2** - REST API (same as v1) + WebSocket real-time updates

**WebSocket Authentication (v2):**
WebSocket endpoints use JWT via subprotocol header:
- JavaScript: `new WebSocket(url, 'access_token.' + jwtToken)`
- Header: `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: access_token.<jwt_token>`

**Migration Path:**
1. v1 REST → v2 REST (no changes, just update base path)
2. v2 REST → v2 WebSocket (replace polling with multiplexed WebSocket)

get.description:
Multiplexed WebSocket for real-time updates across all resources

**Authentication:** JWT token via Sec-WebSocket-Protocol subprotocol
- JavaScript: `new WebSocket(url, 'access_token.' + jwtToken)`
- Header: `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: access_token.<jwt_token>`

**Client → Server Messages (subscribe/unsubscribe):**
```json
{
"action": "subscribe",
"resource": "run",
"ids": ["run-abc123", "run-xyz789"]
}
```

**Resource types:** `run`, `graphrun`, `dashboard`

**Server → Client Messages (updates):**
```json
{
"resource": "run",
"id": "run-abc123",
"event": "updated",
"data": { ... }
}
```

**Available endpoints:**
- `/api/v2/ws/runs` - Subscribe to scenario run updates
- `/api/v2/ws/graphruns` - Subscribe to graph run updates
- `/api/v2/ws/dashboard/active-runs` - Subscribe to dashboard updates

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

checked-at.description:
CheckedAt is the time at which the liveness check was performed.
+optional

cluster-api-url.description: ClusterAPIURL is the API server URL of the managed cluster

cluster-name.description: ClusterName is the name of the managed cluster

online.description:
Online indicates whether the cluster API responded to the liveness check
performed while building this target request. A nil value means that the
provider did not perform a liveness check.
+optional

_comment.description:
Comment is an optional comment describing the scenario
+optional

depends_on.description:
DependsOn is the node ID that this scenario depends on (parent in the graph)
+optional

env.description:
Env is a map of environment variables for the scenario
+optional

image.description:
Image is accepted for backwards compatibility but is never used to select
a pod image; the operator resolves images from Scenario.
+optional

name.description:
Name is the legacy scenario identity field. When Scenario is absent, the
API translates it into a public ScenarioReference.
+optional

registryName.description:
RegistryName is the legacy private registry identity field. Image remains
ignored even when this field is present.
+optional

scenario.description:
Scenario identifies the scenario and registry to resolve for this node.
Metadata-only nodes (whose IDs start with _) may omit this field.
+optional

volumes.description:
Volumes is a map of volume mounts for the scenario
+optional

name.description: Name is the scenario tag/name to resolve.

private.description:
Private selects a saved private registry when true, or krknctl's public
Quay provider when false. A pointer makes the field mandatory on input.

registryName.description: RegistryName identifies the saved private registry when Private is true.

recovered.description: Recovered is the list of pods that recovered with their timing metrics.

build_url.description: BuildURL is the URL of the build used for the cluster.

cluster_version.description: ClusterVersion is the full cluster version string.

etcd_encryption_enabled.description: EtcdEncryptionEnabled indicates whether etcd encryption is enabled.

fips_enabled.description: FIPSEnabled indicates whether FIPS mode is enabled in the cluster.

ipsec_enabled.description: IPSecEnabled indicates whether IPSec is enabled in the cluster.

kubernetes_objects_count.description:
KubernetesObjectsCount maps object kind (e.g. "Pod", "ConfigMap") to the
number of that kind present in the cluster at run time.

major_version.description: MajorVersion is the major version number extracted from ClusterVersion.

network_plugins.description: NetworkPlugins lists the cluster network plugins (e.g. "OVNKubernetes").

node_summary_infos.description:
NodeSummaryInfos lists one summary per distinct node group (role/shape) in
the cluster at run time; nil when the source document carried none.

tag.description: Tag is an arbitrary label applied to the telemetry run.

total_node_count.description: TotalNodeCount is the number of nodes in the cluster at run time.

caCert.description:
CACert is an optional PEM-encoded CA certificate (or bundle) used to trust
a self-signed cluster while keeping TLS verification enabled.

insecureSkipTlsVerify.description:
InsecureSkipTLSVerify reports whether TLS certificate verification is
disabled for this config. Surfaced so the admin edit form can show and
re-submit the current setting; it is not a secret.

host.description:
Host is the Elasticsearch host, optionally scheme-bearing (e.g.
"https://es.example.com"). Required.

password.description:
Password is the basic-auth password. Optional; used only with Username and
never persisted server-side.

port.description:
Port is the Elasticsearch port. Optional; must be 0-65535. When 0 the
query client applies the default port.

telemetryIndex.description: TelemetryIndex is the index queried for telemetry documents. Required.

username.description:
Username is the basic-auth user. Optional; when set the connection must
resolve to https (credentials are refused over plaintext HTTP).

count.description: Count is the number of nodes in this group.

instance_type.description: InstanceType is the cloud instance type (e.g. "m5.2xlarge").

kernel_version.description: KernelVersion is the kernel version running on nodes in this group.

kubelet_version.description: KubeletVersion is the kubelet version running on nodes in this group.

nodes_type.description: NodesType is the role of nodes in this group (e.g. "master", "worker").

os_version.description: OSVersion is the operating system version running on nodes in this group.

configName.description:
ConfigName references a saved Elasticsearch config by name; credentials are
resolved server-side. Mutually exclusive with Inline; exactly one is required.

inline.description: Inline carries an ephemeral connection when no saved config is used.

size.description:
Size is the max documents to return. Optional; 0 defaults to DefaultQuerySize
and values above MaxQuerySize are clamped. Unit: documents.

startDate.description:
StartDate and EndDate bound the search by the document timestamp. They are
"yyyy-MM-dd" date strings (as produced by the UI date pickers). Empty
values fall back to a default trailing window in the query client.

documents.description:
Documents is the size-capped page of matched telemetry runs. Length is
bounded by the request Size (see DefaultQuerySize/MaxQuerySize).

stats.description:
Stats summarizes pass/fail across the whole matched window, so Stats.Pass +
Stats.Fail can exceed Total (which counts only the returned documents page).

total.description:
Total is the number of documents in this returned page (len(Documents)),
not the total matched across the window. Unit: documents.

namespace.description: Namespace is the namespace containing the recovered pod.

pod_name.description: PodName is the name of the pod that recovered.

pod_readiness_time.description: PodReadinessTime is the time taken for the pod to become ready. Unit: seconds.

pod_rescheduling_time.description: PodReschedulingTime is the time taken for pod rescheduling. Unit: seconds.

total_recovery_time.description: TotalRecoveryTime is the total time taken for pod recovery. Unit: seconds.

affected_pods.description:
AffectedPods carries per-pod recovery timings for pod_disruption scenarios;
nil when the source document had none.

end_timestamp.description: EndTimestamp is the scenario end time. Unit: Unix seconds (UTC), with fractional precision.

exit_status.description: ExitStatus is the scenario exit code; 0 indicates success, non-zero indicates failure.

parameters.description: Parameters holds scenario-specific configuration as unconstrained JSON (object, array, or other).

scenario_type.description: ScenarioType is the type of chaos scenario executed (e.g. "pod_disruption_scenarios").

start_timestamp.description: StartTimestamp is the scenario start time. Unit: Unix seconds (UTC), with fractional precision.

end_timestamp.description: EndTimestamp is the scenario end time. Unit: Unix seconds (UTC), with fractional precision.

metadata.description:
Metadata holds run-level cluster/infrastructure detail; nil when the
source document carried none of the metadata fields.

namespace.description: Namespace is the target namespace from the run's first scenario.

run_uuid.description: RunUUID uniquely identifies the telemetry run this document represents.

scenario_type.description: ScenarioType is the chaos scenario type from the run's first scenario.

scenarios.description: Scenarios lists every scenario in the run, each with its raw parameters.

start_timestamp.description: StartTimestamp is the scenario start time. Unit: Unix seconds (UTC), with fractional precision.

status.description:
Status is the run outcome: true = pass, false = fail. It applies the
per-scenario exit_status downgrade, so it may differ from the run-level
job_status used by TelemetryStats.

fail.description:
Fail is the count of runs with job_status false across the whole matched
window (not just the returned page). Unit: runs.

pass.description:
Pass is the count of runs with job_status true across the whole matched
window (not just the returned page). Unit: runs.

pass_percent.description:
PassPercent is Pass / (Pass + Fail) * 100 across the matched window.
Range: 0-100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no runs match.

caCert.description:
CACert is an optional PEM-encoded CA certificate (or bundle) trusted in
addition to the host's system root CAs, so a self-signed cluster is reachable
with TLS verification still enabled and publicly trusted chains keep working.
It is a pointer to make omission (nil, "leave the stored CA unchanged")
distinguishable from an explicit empty string ("clear the stored CA").

insecureSkipTlsVerify.description:
InsecureSkipTLSVerify disables TLS certificate verification entirely. It is
a restricted last resort for self-signed clusters without CA material;
prefer CACert. A nil pointer leaves the stored setting unchanged; a non-nil
value explicitly sets or clears it.
